description: January 14 birthday meaning: Capricorn decan 3, birthday number 5, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a January 14 birthday falls in Capricorn, in the third decan, with Saturn as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 5. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Capricorn is cardinal and earth.

sections.heading: January 14 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Mid-January's cold does not slow the 14th. Fourteen reduces to 5, the number of movement and curiosity, and the Mercury sub-ruler of this Capricorn decan amplifies both. With the Sun about twenty-three degrees into the cardinal earth sign, the combination often shows up as a versatile professional who keeps changing the method while holding on to the goal.

On January 14 the Sun usually sits at about 23° Capricorn, in the third decan, where Mercury is the sub-ruler alongside Saturn. Mercury, ruler of Virgo, colours the last decan of Capricorn, from roughly January 11 to January 20. The sign's practical ambition is joined by a sharp, analytical mind. These natives are often described as strategists and problem-solvers who plan carefully, communicate clearly and spot the weak point in a proposal before anyone else does. Their humour can be dry and well timed. Mercury adds a restlessness that may show up as worry about details or overwork. When this decan trusts the thinking it has already done, it tends to make decisions that others recognise as sound only later.

sections.heading: January 14 in numerology
paragraphs: A 14th birthday reduces as 1 + 4 = 5, giving a birthday number of 5. The compound blends the 1's independence and the 4's structure into the 5's love of change, which makes for an interesting push and pull: a wish for freedom alongside a need for order. Some traditions also count 14 among the karmic debt numbers, linked with learning moderation. Fourteenth-born people are often described as versatile and quick to adapt, especially when they have a stable base to return to. This secondary number tends to reward balance over excess and variety with an anchor.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one January 14 birthday to the next: it is 4 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on January 14: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A January birthday arrives in the depths of northern winter, a season of short days, stock-taking and fresh resolutions; south of the equator it falls in high summer instead. Most of the month belongs to Capricorn, with Aquarius taking over around January 20. In numerology January is month 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, which suits a birthday that sits right at the start of the calendar. January 14 is the 14th day of the year. By January 21, 7 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Aquarius.

For the Chinese zodiac, January 14 always falls before Lunar New Year, which arrives between January 21 and February 20, so someone born on this date takes the animal of the previous calendar year. Well-known people born on January 14 include Albert Schweitzer (1875), Yukio Mishima (1925) and Jason Bateman (1969).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is January 14?
faq.answer: January 14 is Capricorn in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Capricorn, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on January 14?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On January 14 the Life Path is 4 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 5 for everyone born on the 14th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on January 14?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology counts the year from Lunar New Year, never earlier than January 21, so a January 14 birthday belongs to the animal of the year before the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on January 14?
faq.answer: January 14 is also the birthday of Albert Schweitzer (1875), Yukio Mishima (1925) and Jason Bateman (1969). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
